limitations: All 122 cases have a passing receipt across the original full run and focused corrections, not a second falsely clean full-suite run.
Initial custom transport missed MJS types/root redirect; instrumentation initially mislabeled hosted Search/Team Match phases. Preserved failures and corrected exact phases are separate.
Eight pre-existing public imports omitted by the old package boundary were added; all original bundle file bytes remain unchanged.

The 14 affected browser cases passed on canonical assembly v4 after the query cache optimization; other evidence is reused only for unchanged bodies. Full functional passing coverage does not override memory/scientific failures.
Axe has zero automated violations in the four latest scans, with incomplete rules retained explicitly; no physical device or exhaustive manual accessibility certification.
